name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.39.0 — the genesis architect stage becomes driver-stepped (specs/20260825/04-genesis-driver.md). New `spec/scripts/genesis-driver.js` (`spec-paths genesis-driver`) derives state from `.claude/genesis/status.json` (schemaVersion 2, now carrying `marks`, `menus`, `scaffold`, `zeroDayGate`) plus the artifacts actually on disk on every invocation, executes every deterministic step itself (the coverage-audit gate, the registry check per menu, the decision-record closure check, the scaffold command, the zero-day gate, the roadmap closure check), and prints only the one step needing this session's judgment. `/spec:genesis-architect` is deleted; the new `/spec:genesis` command loops on the driver until `HANDOFF`. Every accepted `--mark` prints a checkpoint line (`✅ checkpoint — genesis state saved (<prev> → <next>); safe to /clear and re-run /spec:genesis`), so a full genesis run is safe across as many `/clear`s as it needs. `/spec:genesis-explore` and `/spec:genesis-design` are unchanged except for the predecessor's new name. 7.38.1 — currency is executed, not opined (specs/20260825/03-genesis-currency-executed.md). The `wf-research.js` `Verify` phase — the Haiku "still current?" pass, `RECENCY_VERDICT_SCHEMA`, `verifyKeys`, `still_current` — is deleted; every option menu now carries a required `packages: [{registry, name, version}]` field, resolved by the new `spec/scripts/registry-check.js` (`spec-paths registry-check`) against npm, PyPI, crates.io's per-version JSON endpoints and endoflife.date's cycle list. A `missing` package (a fake-major or a slopsquat name) drops its option into `droppedForCurrency` before the user ever sees the menu; unreachable registries stamp every option `unverified` and never block (exit 3). `genesis-architect.md`, `genesis-design.md`, and `genesis-explore.md`'s menu steps now run the script with `--write` after each `wf-research` call. 7.38.0 — the replay harness's scratch worktree stops leaking its own provenance to the blind reviewer (specs/20260826/01-replay-scratch-path-blindness.md). `replay.js --setup` now derives `{dir}` itself from the target spec (`merge-back.sh branch-for`'s build-worktree stem, `/`→`-`, plus a random 6-hex suffix) instead of doctrine handing sessions a `.claude/worktrees/replay-<random>` example to paraphrase; `replay.md` describes the derivation and never supplies a copyable name. A supplied `--dir` whose basename opens with `replay` (case-insensitive) is now refused outright (exit 3, remedy: omit `--dir` and pass `--spec`), mirroring the existing commit-subject refusal. The private-git-dir marker is renamed `replay-worktree` → `scratch-worktree` everywhere it's planted, guarded, or read (`replay.js`, `block-cross-worktree-writes.sh`, `replay.md`). Caveat: the six `stage:"replay"` ledger rows recorded before this fix were measured under a path tell — real observations, but not proof blindness held; the defensible catch rate starts at the first row after this spec's close.
